mapper.select: SELECT id, material_id, qty, amount, unit_cost FROM wms_material_cost WHERE material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY material_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(s.qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.material_id IN #{id} AND w.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' GROUP BY s.material_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_material_cost SET qty = #{qty}, amount = #{amount}, unit_cost = #{unitCost}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
